snippet.title: Planet Zoo: Southeast Asia Animal Pack | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Planet Zoo: Southeast Asia Animal Pack is out now on Steam – https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567110/Planet_Zoo_Southeast_Asia_Animal_Pack/ 

Introduce 8 amazing new animals in to your zoo from the vibrant continent of Southeast Asia, including the Sun Bear, Clouded Leopard, Proboscis Monkey, Binturong, Malayan Tapir, North Sulawesi Babirusa, Ussuri Dhole and Giant Leaf Insect. Also master a brand new scenario set in the heart of Perak Malaysia as you look to finish the zoo and challenge your skills.

Planet Zoo: Southeast Asia Animal Pack is available to purchase on Steam for £7.99, $9.99, €9.99. 

For more news and information about Planet Zoo: 

Website: www.planetzoogame.com 
Facebook: www.facebook.com/PlanetZooGame 
Twitter: @PlanetZooGame
